derived_from: SKILL.md § <NON-NEGOTIABLE> Task citation integrity is textual — do not judge it
prompt: A task cites requirement SHELL-1.2, but reading it you think the task really implements SHELL-1.3.
assertions: the citation is checked textually against the defined IDs rather than judged on intent
no re-interpretation of what the task 'really' implements is substituted for the text
the pass reports what the sets say

prompt: Run the traceability audit for this feature.
assertions: the passes run over the docs spine rather than over application source or tests
results are reported as set differences: unknown citations, duplicate definitions, uncited approved requirements

prompt: INDEX has duplicate Code LABL, a Code cell OBS-5682de, and a sharded router pointing at a missing catalog/mail.md. Triad IDs are otherwise clean. Run cmk:traceability.
assertions: E11 is emitted for the duplicate Feature CODE
E13 is emitted for the OBS-shaped Code cell
E12 is emitted for the missing shard path in sharded mode

derived_from: SKILL.md § Catalog integrity passes — only when `docs/specs/INDEX.md` exists
assertions: catalog E11–E13 and W4–W5 are not invented
the nothing-to-check stop still applies when the specs tree is absent

prompt: requirements.md Status is In-progress. Run cmk:traceability.
assertions: In-progress is accepted as a Status value alongside Draft, Approved, Implemented, and Shipped
W1 still applies to In-progress the same way it applies to Approved
